title: Enchiladas
steps: Cook meat and onion in skillet. Drain. Add chili powder, garlic, and pepper until meat is browned.
Simmer 1 can enchilada sauce with meat for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile in heavy skillet, heat oil. Using tongs, dip tortillas one at a time in hot oil for 10 seconds or until limp. Add more oil if needed. Drain on paper towel.
Assemble: spoon 1/4 cup meat mix on each tortilla. Sprinkle with 2 tsp of each cheese. Fold tortilla. Secure with toothpick.
Arrange in 13x9x2 dish. Combine remaining 1 can enchilada sauce — pour over remaining tortillas.
Sprinkle remaining cheese. Spread half meat sauce on top. Repeat layers.
Bake covered at 350°F for 20 min until heated. Bake uncovered 5 min. Makes 12.
Garnish with sliced green onions, sour cream, guacamole, and Spanish rice.
